baseline_red.red_is_attributable: All four profiles fail at root resolution while the productive baseline contains no format registration. This RED is evidence of the missing root only, not evidence about any format child.

revision.expected_discriminatory_gain: P00 and E05 obtain unequivocally distinct build identities from identical positive source while retaining identical language observations; only a passing focal slice releases the remaining campaign.

r1_outcome.reported_hash_precision: Publicly supplied prefixes; full SHA-256 verification is mandatory before preservation or replacement, otherwise Unknown.

r2_build_isolation.all_variants: P00, every E01-E06 and every M01-M08 use separate newly created empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR values; no target cache, fingerprint or incremental state is shared.
r2_build_isolation.e05: Build the exact P00 positive source under debug/dev or another explicitly distinct profile; require a binary SHA-256 different from P00 and the same applicable C01-C10 language observations.
r2_build_isolation.release_condition: E05 Preserved, exact P00 source identity, different binary SHA-256 and unequivocal build identities
r2_build_isolation.stop_condition: Do not execute the remainder and do not make a third local attempt on the same E05 fixture if the focal slice fails.
r2_build_isolation.version_and_bytes: --version and binary bytes establish provenance and distinct identity only; they are not the language observable.

revision.r2_hypothesis: Unique empty Cargo target directories and an explicitly distinct E05 profile will prevent fingerprint reuse, materialize E05 as a different binary from the same source and preserve the positive language vector.

classification_cost.process_or_wall_clock_cost: not present in the public R2 cause; must be recovered from owner receipts or remain Unknown

revision.r3_archive_rule: Before replacement, each owner creates and byte-compares each still-present R2 preseal/mutation-results/oracles/harness/AB/RED artifact and records full source/archive SHA-256. R2 adversary metadata receives the same treatment if it will be reemitted. Prefix-only identity or mismatch is Unknown.

r3_historical_audit_limitation.impact: Historical byte-level auditability of the R2 manifest/contract is limited; the next preseal and any final attestation must disclose this. Semantics, C01-C10, Unknown, mutant meanings and mutation score 1.0 are unchanged.
r3_historical_audit_limitation.preservation_status: Hashes remain identified in R2 receipts, but separate byte-for-byte archives were not created before R3 substitution.
prohibitions: do not reconstruct the prior bytes
do not include R2 manifest/contract in the still-satisfiable archive gate

r3_classifier_policy.exit_0_parseable_json_when_missing_modul: Violated, never Preserved and never Unknown
r3_classifier_policy.recognized_incompatible_semantic_diagnos: Violated, including field access on none

r3_execution_order.full_matrix: P00, E01-E06 and M01-M08 in direct, direct_repeat and reverse order
r3_execution_order.release_condition: M02/M06/M07 Violated and P00/E05 Preserved with valid identities

revision.r3_hypothesis: R2 produced discriminating binaries, but its oracle treated recognized semantic mismatch as parser opacity. The refined classifier should reject M02/M06/M07 without weakening Unknown.

r3_reuse_without_rebuild.allowed_only_if: exact R2 source/build/binary hashes and paths match; mode 0555 is required only for each copied variant-specific executable binary
r3_reuse_without_rebuild.adversary_scope: metadata re-chaining only; no source, worktree or binary change

revision.r4_finality: Revision 4/4 is the last local revision. Any failure requires stopping and human decision; no R5, implicit relaxation, rebuild, parser edit or source change is authorized.
revision.r4_hypothesis: R3 over-scoped mode 0555 from executable binaries to roots/sources and stopped before semantic evaluation. Scoping 0555 to copied binaries while freezing sources by hash/delta and no-write capability should release the unchanged focal gate.
revision.r4_metadata_only: Oracle and adversary may re-chain metadata only; no rebuild, parser alteration, source change or oracle semantic change.

r4_mode_scope.source_immutability: record source paths/modes/hashes/deltas before verification, forbid writes, and require identical hashes/deltas afterward
r4_mode_scope.worktree_roots_and_sources: modes are recorded safety mechanics, not language observables and not required to be 0555

E01-E06: actual execution in direct, direct_repeat and reverse order
M01-M08: actual execution in direct, direct_repeat and reverse order

required_mutant_obligations.mutation: bind format to a dictionary, function or none instead of a module
construct the module with name global, std or the empty string
install the root in only one target or feature profile
make std.format resolve to a distinct module identity
create any placeholder child among svg, png, pdf or html
create a new global alias for a format child
fabricate the expected repr by textual special-casing without installing the correct value

calibration.stop_rule: Two consecutive revisions with the same classification vector and same dominant cause require contract/protocol review before any third full campaign.

language_observables: existence of the public root format
missing-field diagnostic naming format and absent
availability across the four frozen profiles
the exact public-surface delta of one root and zero children
mechanics_excluded: Scope collection type or memory layout
Rust implementation structure beyond architectural gates
upstream Format vector or feature-gate mechanism

claim.allowed_final_wording: The public root `format` is Preserved for the P1461 observable fragment under the four frozen profiles.
forbidden_wording: format children are implemented or equivalent
claim.scope: Only the public root `format` as an always-present, nominal module.

manifest.sha256_state: Current R4 manifest hash measured after finalizing its one-way cross-reference; preseal must remeasure it.

observables.comparison: Parse JSON stdout; require exit code 0 and the exact string `module`.
observables.purpose: The root resolves to a module value, not a dictionary, function, none or textual impostor.

observables.comparison: Parse JSON stdout; require exit code 0 and the exact Unicode string `<module format>`.
observables.purpose: The root has the public nominal identity format.

observables.comparison: Parse JSON stdout; require the exact tuple [`<module format>`, true].
observables.purpose: std.format projects the same language value as the public root; it is not a separately constructed lookalike.

observables.comparison: Parse JSON stdout; require the exact tuple [`<module format>`, true].
observables.purpose: A lexical alias preserves the value identity and nominal representation.

observables.comparison: Run the combined positive tuple in each profile and compare parsed values, not warning text or process scheduling. Every result must be the exact expected tuple.
observables.expression: { let f = format; (repr(type(format)), repr(format), repr(std.format), f == format, std.format == format) }
observables.purpose: The root does not depend on target, html or a11y-extras.

observables.comparison: Require exit code 1 and a structured or losslessly parsed diagnostic with class missing-module-field, module name format, field name absent, and primary span exactly covering the field token `absent` at line 1, columns 7 through 13 exclusive. Presentation glyphs and ANSI are not compared.
observables.purpose: A failed field access is diagnosed on a real module nominally called format, rather than failing at root lookup.

observables.comparison: A fresh P1357 inventory must show the exact per-profile counts and exact path-set delta. Counts alone are insufficient if the changed path cannot be identified as exactly `format`.
observables.purpose: The public-surface change is exactly the root format and nothing else.

observables.comparison: Compare the candidate public path set to the frozen baseline. No newly present candidate path may have prefix `format.`. In addition, each sentinel field access must fail as missing-module-field on module format. This is a negative scope guard, not a parity claim for those children.
observables.purpose: P1461 does not anticipate P1462-P1465 with placeholders, wrappers or aliases.

observables.comparison: The full public inventory delta must be the singleton root `format`; no new global name associated with svg, png, pdf, html or global may appear. Pre-existing names are compared as unchanged set members and receive no new parity credit.
observables.purpose: The materialization does not create global child aliases or disturb existing global paths.

observables.comparison: Run the frozen cases in direct order, direct order repeated, and reverse order. Compare normalized classification vectors and parsed public values. All three vectors must be identical.
observables.purpose: Classification is deterministic and independent of test ordering.

combined_positive.expression: { let f = format; (repr(type(format)), repr(format), repr(std.format), f == format, std.format == format) }

ratified_vanilla_observation.html_warning_note: The ratified vanilla CLI emits its generic html-development warning on stderr for html target probes. That warning is outside the P1461 fragment and is not compared; any error or changed parsed value remains decisive.

in_scope: one always-present public root binding named format
std.format projection of the same language value
generic missing-field diagnostic on module format
availability under default, a11y-extras, html and html+a11y
exact inventory delta caused by the single root
negative_scope: no format.svg, format.png, format.pdf or format.html
no descendants below any format child
no global alias for a format child
no wrapper, stub, placeholder, marker, exporter option, set rule or target-specific root
no change to Module, Scope, Value, lookup semantics, existing global bindings or feature gates
not_claimed: semantic, syntactic or morphological parity of any format child
membership equivalence between vanilla format and the deliberately empty P1461 crystalline module
SVG, PNG, PDF or HTML exporter equivalence

serialization: UTF-8, LF, two-space indentation, deterministic key order

verdict.Preserved: Every mandatory C01-C10 observation passes under every required profile, the mutation score is 1.0, all three orders agree, and no protected hash or capability constraint is violated.
verdict.Unknown: Evidence is opaque, incomplete, untrusted, non-reproducible, outside budget or outside an allowlist. Unknown blocks both preseal and final success.
verdict.Violated: A provenance-valid and parseable observation disagrees with a mandatory expectation or reveals an out-of-scope child, alias or unrelated public-surface change.

triggers: binary identity not equal to the manifest pin
candidate binary not freshly rebuilt and hashed
timeout, signal, OOM, disallowed swap or truncation
use of data or capabilities outside the role allowlist
